claim_boundary: Internal consistency review only; not independent review, peer review, acceptance or publication.

lenses.concern: A successful job/harvest could be mistaken for a successful scientific score.
lenses.resolution: Separate execution-chain pass from two parse-invalid null scores; prohibit arm comparison.

lenses.concern: One task/seed with zero scorable arms cannot support an effect, uncertainty interval or cost-per-success.
lenses.resolution: No aggregate, inferential test or quantitative figure generated.

lenses.concern: Bundle, scheduler, checkout, model and raw records require exact identity.
lenses.resolution: Bind the exact bundle plus all 19 extracted files; retain checkout head/tree, packet parent and equal eight-file pre/post attestations.

lenses.concern: Post-hoc JSON extraction could rescue V4 or admit prose.
lenses.resolution: V4 stays null. V4.1 accepts only bare JSON or one exact lowercase json fence and rejects trailing prose/multiple/nonexact fences.

lenses.concern: Null parsing could be presented as an arm loss or general framework evidence.
lenses.resolution: State no arm won or lost and the matched empirical claim remains unevaluated.

lenses.concern: Internal review could be mislabeled independent.
lenses.resolution: Review class and manuscript explicitly say same-context internal, not peer review.

lenses.concern: An adaptive parser selected after V4 result inspection could be mislabeled chronology-fresh or untouched.
lenses.resolution: Packet, policy, status and manuscript now disclose parent V4 result access and say fresh only to V4.1 outputs; V4.1 is an adaptive non-confirmatory parser replay.

lenses.concern: A pre-merge SHA cannot honestly stand in for the final exact merged execution head.
lenses.resolution: Candidate bytes remain hash-bound; execution separately requires a post-merge batch EXPECTED_REPO_SHA equal to clean checkout HEAD and refs/remotes/origin/main.

lenses.concern: A top-level-only schema could accept missing scheduler evidence, non-null scores, enabled comparisons or duplicate sources.
lenses.resolution: Schema now closes required nested execution/null/residual fields, exact role cardinalities and unique items; hostile mutations are rejected and path uniqueness is asserted in tests.

lenses.concern: The manuscript said deterministic score where both score values are null.
lenses.resolution: The manuscript now says deterministic score record and immediately preserves both null scores.

remaining_empirical_blockers: strong parent and evidence-access factorial absent
